Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Hydrocarbons in Kayes: Resumption of supply
Mali.summary: Kayes, November 4 (AMAP)– Fuel supply has resumed normally in the Kayes Region after two days of disruption. A convoy of several tanker trucks arrived Tuesday, November 3 in the city, around 11 am, under the escort of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), announced the Regional Directorate of Trade . According to the Regional Director of Trade, Robo Bayo, this arrival has strengthened existing stocks at gas stations and outlets, ensuring continuity of supply throughout the region.

Mali.title: Image Africa Illegal gold panning: thousands of Burkinabe repatriated from Guinea
Mali.summary: Burkina Faso is organizing the repatriation of thousands of its nationals from Guinea from this week with the help of Mali, after the prohibition of artisanal gold mining in several areas of the north-east of the country. The Burkinabe Minister of Security is in Bamako on November 4. A sieve with gold glitter .

Mali.title: Burkinabe returnees from Guinea: a government delegation on mission in Bamako
Mali.summary: The Burkinabe Minister of Security, Mahamadou Sana, visited Bamako on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 to inquire about the situation of several thousand compatriots returned from Guinea and to organize their return to Burkina Faso. Burkina Faso's Minister of Security, Police Divisional Commissioner Mahamadou Sana, was received on Wednesday in Bamako by his Malian counterpart, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine Mandated by President Ibrahim Traoré, he came to examine the conditions of care of young Burkinabe gold miners who arrived in Mali after their expulsion from Guinea, according to the Malian Armed Forces.

Mali.title: Military Court of Bamako: eight cases examined in correctional hearing
Mali.summary: The Military Court of Bamako held its ordinary correctional hearing on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, under the chairmanship of Magistrate Assama Dolo. Eight files, involving military and civilians, were on the docket . The cases included acts of fraud, breach of trust, slanderous denunciation, loss of weapons, desertion, disobedience, escape of detainees and violation of military instructions.

Mali.title: Mali: Kouremalé faced with the influx of thousands of people from Guinea
Mali.summary: The suspension of artisanal gold panning in Siguiri prefecture, Guinea, caused the forced return of thousands of foreign gold miners, including Malians and Burkinabe. Faced with this influx, the authorities announce measures to welcome the people concerned, provide them with assistance and facilitate their return to their respective countries In a statement issued on Tuesday, November 3, the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC) ensures that arrangements are made to assist the nationals concerned and organize their return.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Illegal gold panning: Hundreds of Africans driven from Guinea arrive in Bamako
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 4 (AMAP)– African nationals, mostly from a member country of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), arrive in Bamako after leaving gold mining sites in Guinea, following measures taken by the Guinean authorities against clandestine and illegal mining . At the Djicoroni-Para autogare, several of them are waiting to find the necessary means to return to Burkina Faso, AMAP noted.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: South Africa: increased security for municipal elections
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 4 (AMAP) South African security forces have been placed on heightened alert for Wednesday's municipal elections, after 21 incidents recorded during the special vote, according to the National Joint Operations and Intelligence Structure (NATJOINTS) . Events reported on Monday and Tuesday include killings, theft of election materials, arson, intimidation and damage to campaign materials.

Mali.title: FIGHT AGAINST TERRORISM: THE AIR FORCE ANNIHILATES A TERRORIST GROUP NEAR GOURMA-RHAROUS
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) conducted three (03) aerial interventions resulting in four (04) strikes against positions of terrorist armed groups in the sectors of Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous The operations, carried out on November 2 and 3, 2026, (…)By Mahamane TOURE – NEW HORIZONRETROUVE the REST OF YOUR ARTICLE IN the NEW HORIZON OF WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 4, 2026 Follow us on Facebook, Telegram, WhatsApp to miss nothing of Malian news Follow us on Facebook, Telegram, WhatsApp to miss nothing of Malian news

Mali.title: Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous:...
Mali.summary: Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous: the Noose is tightening around terrorist groups As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out airstrikes in different localities of our country between 2 and 3 November 2026 . In a statement issued yesterday by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, it appears that on Monday, November 2, 2026, the use of precise information made it possible to locate, thirty kilometers east of Niono, a major base housing armed terrorist groups as well as war material, including armed vehicles.

Mali.title: Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous: the Noose is tightening around terrorist groups As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out airstrikes in different localities of our country between 2 and 3 November 2026.
Mali.summary: In a statement issued yesterday by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, it appears that on Monday, November 2, 2026, the use of precise information made it possible to locate, thirty kilometers east of Niono, a large base housing armed terrorist groups as well as war equipment, including armed vehicles. After confirming the collected information, the position has been processed successfully On the same day, twenty-eight kilometers south of Tessalit, a terrorist assembly point housing several individuals and war materiel was precisely spotted and struck.

Mali.title: 2nd coordination meeting of the military frequencies of the ESA countries: The work opened in Bamako The Minister of Communication, the Digital Economy and the Modernization of the Administration, Alhamdou Ag Ilyène, took part, on Monday, November 2, 2026, in Bamako, in the opening ceremony of the second coordination meeting of the military frequencies of the member countries of the Confederation of Sahel States (ESA).
Mali.summary: A view of the Presidium at the opening ceremony The ceremony was presided over by the Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence and Veterans Affairs, Major General Oumarou Diarra, in the presence of the President of the Telecommunications, Information and Communication Technologies and Posts Regulatory Authority of Mali (AMRTP), Saïdou Pona Sankaré . Organised by AMRTP from 2 to 4 November 2026, this strategic meeting aims to strengthen cooperation between Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger in the management and coordination of radio frequencies used by the Defence and Security Forces .

Mali.title: Guinea: 22 directors expelled for complicity in illegal gold panning in Siguiri
Mali.summary: Guinea: 22 directors removed for complicity in illegal gold panning in Siguiri The Guinean President, Mamadi Doumbouya, signed on November 3, 2026 a decree deleting 22 territorial administrators, civilian and military, stationed in the Siguiri region. They are permanently excluded from the civil service and the defence and security forces The spokesman of the Presidency, General Amara Camara, read the decree on national television (RTG).

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Mali-Guinea: an influx of foreign nationals reported at the border
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 4 (AMAP) A large influx of nationals of various nationalities is currently observed at the border between Mali and Guinea, towards the District of Bamako, announced Wednesday the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC), in a statement of the Inter-Ministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management This situation follows the measures taken by the Guinean authorities to put an end to clandestine and illegal gold panning on their territory, says the communiqué issued at the end of an emergency meeting held at the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection, under the chairmanship of…

Mali.title: Mali-Guinea: An influx of gold miners at the Kouremale border, CECOGEC announces reception measures...
Mali.summary: Mali-Guinea: Flux of gold miners at the Kouremale border, CECOGEC announces reception and repatriation measures The Ministry of Security and Civil Protection is sounding the alarm . In a press release No. 2026-05 published on November 3, 2026 and signed by Colonel Fireman Issa Raoul Dana DABO, the Center for Coordination and Crisis Management (CECOGEC) reports a large influx of nationals of various nationalities on the border between Mali and Guinea, towards the District of Bamako .

Mali.title: Mali-Guinea Border Migration: Security Authorities Take Charge
Mali.summary: COMMUNIQUÉ No. 2026-05 OF the INTERMINISTERIEL Committee FOR CRISIS and DISASTER MANAGEMENT Following an emergency meeting held today at the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection chaired by the Secretary General, the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC) informs national public opinion that a large influx of nationals of various nationalities is currently observed at the border between Mali and the Guinea, towards Bamako District.

Mali.title: Between Us: Realism
Mali.summary: By press release dated 24 October 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced the discovery, in a camp in Tagadayat about 35 km south-east of the city of Menaka, of 54 lifeless bodies . A week earlier, on October 19, the Executive Office of the Idaksahak Community spoke of "the massacre of 48 civilians, which occurred on Sunday, October 18, 2026, in the locality of Tagadayat, in the region of Menaka, by armed elements of Daesh, arrived on board several motorcycles" .

Burkina Faso.title: HRW Demands Burkina Faso Govt Probe Civilian Killings
Burkina Faso.summary: Human Rights Watch (HRW) has urged Burkinabe authorities to strengthen protections for vulnerable communities, investigate human rights abuses, and "fairly prosecute" those responsible following a wave of attacks by an Al-Qaeda-linked armed group that killed dozens of civilians. According to HRW, fighters from the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) attacked a gold mining site on September 1, killing 24 people.

Burkina Faso.title: Nouga: six Burkinabe gold miners die in the collapse of a gallery
Burkina Faso.summary: Six people, all of Burkinabe nationality, lost their lives in the collapse of a mining well transformed into a gallery, on an isolated gold mining site in the village of Dioulafoundou, in the rural commune of Nouga, in the circle of Kangaba . According to Essor, as soon as he was informed, the prefect of the circle went on site with the officials of the police, gendarmerie, national guard, civil protection and other technical services.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso repatriates more than 8,000 nationals of Guinea after the ban on gold panning
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso repatriates more than 8,000 nationals from Guinea after gold panning ban The Burkinabe government has mobilized a convoy of hundreds of buses to repatriate more than 8,000 nationals from Guinea, in response to the ban on artisanal gold mining and a situation of increasing distress Burkina Faso is organizing the repatriation of thousands of its nationals from Guinea this week, after measures taken by Conakry against illegal gold panning, AFP learned Wednesday from a source in the Burkinabe government and a state media.

Burkina Faso.title: An Islamist armed group targeted civilians in Burkina Faso
Burkina Faso.summary: - Burkina Faso: Islamist armed group targeted civilians HRW, 4 November 2026 GSIM carried out a deadly attack on a mine site, and evidently used banned explosive devices in a northern province Plus' GSIM carried out a deadly attack on a mine site, and evidently used banned explosive devices in a northern province An al-Qaeda-linked armed group killed at least 27 civilians in two attacks in Yatenga province, northern Burkina Faso, in September 2026.

Burkina Faso.title: Kangaba: Six dead in the landslide...
Burkina Faso.summary: Kangaba: Six dead in the landslide of a mining well in Nouga Six people died last Friday in the landslide of a mining well, transformed into a gallery, in the rural commune of Nouga, precisely on a very isolated gold mining site in the village of Dioulafoundou. According to our information, the people who died are all nationals of Burkina Faso Immediately informed, the Prefect of Circle, accompanied by the officials of the Police, the National Gendarmerie, the National Guard, the Civil Protection Rescue Center, the sanitation and water and forest services, went to the scene.

Burkina Faso.title: Kangaba: Six dead in the landslide of a mining well in Nouga Six people died last Friday in the landslide of a mining well, transformed into a gallery, in the rural commune of Nouga, precisely on a very isolated gold panning site in the village of Dioulafoundou.
Burkina Faso.summary: The victims are all nationals of Burkina Faso According to our information, the people who died are all nationals of Burkina Faso. As soon as he was informed, the circle prefect, accompanied by the leaders of the Police, the National Gendarmerie, the National Guard, the Civil Protection Rescue Centre, the sanitation and water and forest services, went to the scene .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: The army eliminates terrorist leader Saidou Diallo, aka Djabiri Mangan the one-eyed
Burkina Faso.summary: The fighting forces launched an offensive against the terrorists affiliated with the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (GSIM), entrenched in the Konga forest in the Sourou. During a skilfully executed operation on October 29, 2026, several terrorists were neutralized and bases dismantled Among the terrorists killed was Saidou Diallo, alias Djabiri Mangan dit le Borgne, an important terrorist leader in the Sourou Region.

Burkina Faso.summary: GSIM carried out a deadly attack on a mine site, and clearly used banned explosive devices in a northern province - An al-Qaeda-linked armed group killed at least 27 civilians in two attacks in Yatenga province, northern Burkina Faso, in September 2026. - Unrelenting illegal attacks by GSIM put civilians at serious risk across Burkina Faso . Burkina Faso.summary: Deadly Attack on Mining Site; Apparent Use of Banned Explosive Devices in Northern Province - An Al-Qaeda-linked armed group killed at least 27 civilians in two attacks in Burkina Faso's northern Yatenga province in September 2026. - The group's relentless, unlawful attacks put civilians across Burkina Faso at grave risk. Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Two fiancés die in Tenkodogo after an altercation involving a firearm
Burkina Faso.summary: A trader and a non-commissioned officer of the defense and security forces, presented as fiancés, died at the Tenkodogo Regional Hospital Center (CHR) after an altercation that occurred on the night of November 1 to 2, 2026 in Sector 6, according to testimonies collected by the Burkina Faso Information Agency (AIB) . The two victims, identified as Jeanne Yoda and Adama Tiendrébéogo, allegedly had an argument near a pharmacy, not far from the hospital.

Burkina Faso.title: Field-tested, the Burkinabe army has developed "unique combat modes in the world", PM
Burkina Faso.summary: In the field, the Burkinabe army has developed "unique combat modes in the world", PM Ouagadougou, Oct. 30, 2026 (AIB)-The Burkinabe Combat Forces have developed, thanks to the experience gained in the field, unique combat modes in the world that they can share with their Russian brothers, welcomed Prime Minister Rimtalba Jean Emmanuel Ouédraogo, during an interview in Moscow with Russian television RT .

Niger.title: Presentation ceremony at the flag of the 2025 contingent of the FANs at the Aroungouza Training Centre in Zinder
Niger.summary: Zinder, 04 Nov (ANP)- The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Maman Sani Kiaou chaired, Wednesday, November 4, the ceremony of presentation to the flag of the 2025 Contingent of the Niger Armed Forces (FAN) trained at the Aroungouza Instruction Center (about 15 km north of Zinder), in front of a large audience After several months of training, these new recruits have received the physical, technical and tactical skills necessary to accomplish their missions in the service of the nation In his speech, the Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Maman Sani Kiaou declared himself "honored to be in the…

Niger.title: Chadian president meets Algerian foreign minister in Ndjamena
Niger.summary: Chadian President Mahamat Idriss Deby Itno on Tuesday met with Algerian Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf at the presidential palace in N'Djamena. The two countries discussed enhancing bilateral and the implementation of cooperation agreements signed during Deby's visit to Algiers last year. Observers say Algeria, which this week deployed troops to Niger seeks to regain influence in the Sahel.

Niger.title: Algeria prepares to launch Nigerian part of trans-Saharan gas pipeline
Niger.summary: Algerian diplomat: The completion of the Nigerian part of the trans-Saharan gas pipeline will start soon - Enhancing security and economic cooperation: Algeria strengthens cooperation with Niger to confront terrorist threats, and supports the re-establishment in Niger through training programs, which enhances the economic partnership after signing twenty cooperation agreements - Integrative projects and economic initiatives: Algeria supports African integration with projects such as the Trans-Saharan Road and a railway line towards Niamey, with a joint military agreement to enhance security and protect energy…

Niger.title: Niger: after military support, Algeria launches mediation with Chad
Niger.summary: Algeria is stepping up its involvement in the security challenges of the Sahel. After strengthening its military cooperation with Niger, Algiers now seems to favor the diplomatic route to bring Niamey and N’Djamena, whose relations are marked by tensions. It is certainly in this perspective that Ahmed Attaf, Algerian Minister of Foreign Affairs, paid a visit to Chad and then Niger Indeed, on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, he went to N’Djamena as special envoy of President Abdelmadjid Tebboune where he was received by Chadian President Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno.

Niger.title: Niger signs cooperation deal with military leader in eastern Libya
Niger.summary: Niger signed a memorandum of understanding with eastern Libya’s military commander Khalifa Haftar on Sunday to strengthen their bilateral relations. The agreement to expand cooperation in “various fields” was approved by Nigerien Prime Minister Ali Mahaman Lamine Zeine. He visited Benghazi together with several political and military officials.

Niger.title: An example of cooperation :
Niger.summary: This is an example of South-South cooperation that must do its bit on the African continent. Algeria has decided to provide military support to its neighbour, Niger, with which it had, until recently, tense relations. If relations between the two had been somewhat blurred, pragmatism eventually took over, giving way to a return to a warming of cooperation between the two countries .

Niger.title: Niger-Libya cooperation: Prime Minister Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine visits Benghazi
Niger.summary: Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine led a large delegation including the Chief of Staff of the President of the Republic, Brigadier General Ibro, the Chief of Staff of the Army, General Zataka, Colonel Major Bello of the Ministry of Defence, the Secretary General of the Government as well as his special adviser, Alambo During this visit, Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine was also received by General Saddam Haftar, Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Libyan Armed Forces, in the presence of Dr.
